verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
verses.sm: Isaako e Iakopo. Ua faamanuia Isaako ia Iakopo ma Esau e Ua toeaina Isaako, ua puaoa foi ona mata ua le mafai ai ona vaai, ona ia valaau ai lea ia Esau lona atalii e matua, ma fai atu ia te ia, O le tauto. ai lea, Faauta ea, ua ou toeaina aʻu,

verses.en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.sm: Lo‘u atalii e; ona fai mai ai lea o ia, O aʻu lenei. Ona ia fai atu ou te le iloa le aso ou te oti ai;

verses.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
verses.sm: o lenei, ina ave ia au auupega, o lau utu ma lau aufana, ma e alu i le vao e tuli se manu o le vao ma au.

verses.en: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.sm: Ja e fai ai sina mea e ʻai e manogi ma a'u, pei o le mea ou te manao ai, ma au mai ia te au, ou te ‘ai ai, ina ia ou faamanuia atu ia te oe manii ou te lei oti.

verses.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo foi Repeka i le upu a Isaako ia Esau lona atalii. Ua alu atu foi Esau i le vao e tuli se manu, e au mai ai.

verses.en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Repeka ia lakopo lana tama, ua faapea atu, Faauta, na ou faalogo i le upu a lou tama ia Esau lou uso, ua faapea,

verses.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
verses.sm: Au mai ia te au se manu mai le vao, ma fai ai sina mea e ‘ai e manogi ma aʻu, ou te ‘ai ai, ma ou faamanuia atu ia te oe i luma o le ALII, mani ou te lei oti.

verses.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.sm: O lenei, laʻu tama e, ia e faalogo mai i laʻu upu i le mea ou te fai atu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.sm: Ia e alu i le fagaga, ma au mai ai ia te au tamai “oti lelei se lua, ou te fai ai se mea e “ai e manogi ma lou tama, pei o le mea E manao ai o ia:

verses.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.sm: Io Ona E avatu ai lea i lou tama, e ‘ai ai o ia, ina ia faamanuia mai o ia ia te oe mani o lei oti o ia.

verses.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o lakopo ia Repeka lona tina, Faauta, o le tagata taufulufulu loʻu uso o Esau, a o aʻu ou te se tagata lamolemole.

verses.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.sm: Atonu e tagotago lo'u tama ia te au, ona avea ai lea o aʻu ia te ia ma tagata faa‘ole‘ole, ona oo mai ai lea ia te au se fetuu, a e le o se manuia. O le vai eli o le tauto.

verses.en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o lona tina ia te ia, La'u tama e, ia ia te au lou fetuu, tau lava ina e faalogo mai i lau upu, ma e alu e au mai ai tamai “oti ia te au.

verses.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia, ma pupue mai, ua au mai i lona tina, ona fai ai lea e lona tina mea e “ai e manogi, pei ona manao ai lona tama.

verses.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
verses.sm: Ua ave foi e Repeka ofu lelei o lana tama e matua o Esau, sa ia te ia i le fale, ua na faaofu ai ia Iakopo lana tama aupito itiiti;

verses.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.sm: ua ia tuu ai foi pa'u o tamai “on i ona lima, atoa ma le lamolemole o lona ua;

verses.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.sm: ua ia tuu atu le mea e ‘ai e manogi ma le areto na ia saunia i le lima o lana tama o Iakopo.

verses.en: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o ia i lona tama, ua fai atu, Lo'u tama e; ona ia fai mai ai lea, O aʻu lenei, lo‘u atalii e, o ai ea oe?

verses.en: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Iakopo i lona tama, O atu o Esau o lau ulumatua, ua ou faia le mea na e fai mai ai ia te au; ina nofo ia i luga, ia nofo ma ‘ai i lau manu ina ia e faamanuia mai ia te au.

verses.en: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Isaako i lona atalii, Lo‘u atalii e, pe faapefea ona e vave maua? Ua ia fai atu, Aua na aumaia i Ou luma e le ALII lou Atua.

verses.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Isaako ia Iakopo, Tou atalii e, soso mai ia, ina ia ou tagotago ia te oe, po o oe loʻu lava atalii o Esau pe leai.

verses.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
verses.sm: Ua soso atu Iakopo ia Isaako lona tama; ona ia tagotago mai ai lea ia te ia, ua fai mai, O le leo o le leo lea o Iakopo, a o lima o lima ia o Esau.

verses.en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
verses.sm: Ua ia le iloa o ia, aua ua taufulufulu ona lima, pei o lima o Esau lona uso; ona faamanuia ai lea e ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, O oe ea o lo'u lava atalii o Esau? Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, O atu lava lenei.

verses.en: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, Au mai ia ia te au, ou te “ai ai le manu a loʻu atalii, ina ia ou faamanuia ia te oe. Ona ia avatu ai lea ia te ia, na ia ‘ai ai, ua na au mai foi ia te ia le uaina, ona ia inu ai lea.

verses.en: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Isaako lona tama ia te ia, Lo'u atalii e, soso mai ia, seʻi e sogi mai ia te au.

verses.en: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
verses.sm: Ona ia soso atu ai lea, ma sogi atu ia te ia; ua ia lagona le nanamu o ona ofu, ma faamanuia ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Faauta, o le manogi o loʻu atalii, e pei o le manogi o le fanua ua faamanuia e le ALII;

verses.en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
verses.sm: ia foai atu e le Atua ia te ce le sau mai le lagi, ma le lelei o le fanua, ma saito ma uaina e tele.

verses.en: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
verses.sm: Ia auauna nuu ia te oe, ia ifo foi tagata ia te oe, ia fai oe ma alii i ou uso, ia ifo foi tama a lou tina ia te oe; ia fetuuina se fetuu ia te oe, ia manuia foi se faamanuia ia te oe.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona faamanuia e Isaako ia Iakopo, na seʻi alu atu foi Iakopo ai luma o Isaako lona tama, ona sau ai lea o Esau lona uso i lana tuligamanu.

verses.en: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.sm: Na faia foi e ia le mea e “ai e manogi, ma avatu i lona tama, ua faapea atu i lona tama, Lo'u tama e, ia e nofo i luga, ma ‘ai i le manu a lou atalii, ina ia e faamanuia mai ia te au.

verses.en: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Isaako lona tama ia te ia, O ai ea oe? Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, O aʻu o lou atalii, o lau ulumatua o Esau.

verses.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
verses.sm: Ona tetemu ai lea o Isaako, ua matua tele lava lona tetemu, ua fai mai, O ai lava lea na tuli manu, ma au mai la te au, ua uma ona Ou ‘ai ai a e te lei sau oe, ua ou faamanuia foi ia te ia, e manuia lava ia?

verses.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Esau i upu a lona tama, ona tagiaue ai lea o ia i le ane faalotulotu, ua faapea atu i lona tama, Lo'u tama e, ia e faamanuia mai atoa foi ma a‘u nei.

verses.en: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, Na sau faa‘ole‘ole lou uso, ua na ave lou manuia.

verses.en: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, E le o lea ea ua igoa ai o 1a o lakopo? aua ua atu lua lona sisio mai ia te au, na ia fao le tofi o aʻu le ulumatua, faauta foi, ua ia fao nei loʻu manwa. Ua ia fai atu foi, E leai ca se manuia o totoe ia te oe mo aʻu?

verses.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Isaako, ua faapea mai ia Esau, Faauta, ua ou toua o ia e fai ma alii ia te oe, ua ou tuu atu foi ia te ia ona uso uma e fai ma auauna, ua ou faamalosia ia i le saito ma le uaina, se a foi se mea ou te toe fai ma oe, loʻu atalii ?

verses.en: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Esau i lona tama, E tasi ea le manuia ua ia te oe, loʻu tama è? Ia e faaamanuia ia te au, o au lava, loʻu tama e. Ona tagi ai lea o Esau ma le leo tele.

verses.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o lona tama o Isaako, ua fai mai ia te ja, Faauta, o le fanua lafulemu le mea e te nofo ai, e 1010 ifo foi le sau mai le lagi i luga.

verses.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.sm: O lau pelu e te ola ai, e te auauna foi i lou uso; a oo foi ina faasaoloto o oe ona e gausia ai lea o lana amo nai lou ua.

verses.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.sm: Ua ita tele Esau ia Iakopo ona O le manuia na faamanuia atu ai e lona tama ia te ia; ona faapea lea o Esau i lona loto, Ua latalata aso e faanoanoa ai ona o lo'u tama, ona ou fasioti ai lea loʻu uso o lakopo.

verses.en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
verses.sm: Ua talaina atu ia Repeka upu a Esau lana tama e matua, Ona ia feau atu ai lea e sau lana tama aupito itiiti o lakopo, ua fai acu ia tè ia, Faauta, o lou uso o Esau, o loo faamafanafana ia i lona loto ia te oe, o le a fasioti ia te oe.

verses.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
verses.sm: A o lenei, laʻu tama e, ia e faalogo mai i lau upu; ina tu ia i luga, ma e sola atu i lo'u tuagane o Lapana, i Karana,

verses.en: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
verses.sm: ma e nofo al nai aso, seia mavae atu le ita o lou uso;

verses.en: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
verses.sm: seia mavae atu le ita o lou uso ia te oe, seia galo foi ia te ia le mea ua e faia ia te ia; ona ou feau atu ai lea, e aami ia te oe i lea mea; e aveeseina i se a oulua ia te au i le aso e tasi?

verses.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Repeka ia Isaako, Ou te uu i loʻu ola ona o fafine o sa Heti, afai e fai ava lakopo i se fafine o sa Heti, pei o ia fafine o le nuu, pe se a le toe aoga o lo'u ola ia te au? Ua alu malaga
